coarse_key_preservation.description: The coarse table and document macros do not preserve candidate keys through a document-derived predicate and back to a table answer field.
coarse_key_preservation.required_contract: Keyed document answers and predicate outcomes must retain source-row keys and yield a KeySet for answer projection.

document_predicate_to_keyset.description: Document-derived comparison outcomes cannot be converted to the KeySet needed to select the associated table candidate.
document_predicate_to_keyset.required_contract: A declared predicate over keyed evidence must return the keys whose evidence satisfies it.

fine_document_key_preservation.description: Fine sentence and span outputs lose the subject key required for later candidate selection and map-back.
fine_document_key_preservation.required_contract: Sentence and span evidence must preserve the originating candidate key through parsing and comparison.

date_part_projection.description: The vocabulary can parse a date but cannot project a requested calendar component such as birth month.
date_part_projection.required_contract: A typed DateSet and declared component must produce the corresponding ValueSet while retaining provenance.

semantic_text_predicate.description: The candidate plan needs semantic entailment or entity-type classification rather than literal string comparison.
semantic_text_predicate.required_contract: A declared reusable text predicate must evaluate keyed evidence without embedding a question-specific answer template.

boolean_predicate_combination.description: Several independently evaluated constraints must be combined while preserving candidate keys.
boolean_predicate_combination.required_contract: Keyed predicate results and an explicit AND/OR policy must produce one keyed predicate result.

fuzzy_date_selection.description: The phrase 'about 1930' requires an explicit tolerance policy that exact date comparison does not define.
fuzzy_date_selection.required_contract: A parsed date, target date, and declared tolerance policy must yield a keyed approximate-match result.

grouped_aggregation.description: Counting repeated event rows by candidate requires an explicit grouping contract absent from this candidate plan.
grouped_aggregation.required_contract: Rows and a group key must produce a KeyedValueSet of per-group aggregate values.
